purpose: Cover every acceptance criterion of US-18005 with one node:test case each in test/view/readiness-layout.test.js; DEFINE lands the named declarations flagged not yet built so the strict coverage audit binds each criterion, and BUILD (FBS-206) removes the flags as it makes them pass.

testCases.description: [happy] Given readiness.stages, when the overview sub-view renders, then a stage grid shows each stage as a row and the scopes "tree" and "delta" as columns, each VerdictGridCell carrying VerdictGridCell.pass, VerdictGridCell.total and VerdictGridCell.state, with VerdictGridCell.failing rendered as a link into the blocking table filtered to that stage.

[happy] Given the Readiness tab, when it renders, then a SubTabStrip offers "Overview", "Questions", "Blocking", "Coverage" and "Trace", the active key is written into the hash as sub=, and the router restores it on load and after an SSE innerHTML swap of #rcf-live-content.

[happy] Given an unfrozen tree, when the delta block renders, then DeltaCounts.changed, DeltaCounts.added, DeltaCounts.removed, DeltaCounts.briefSince, DeltaCounts.impacted and DeltaCounts.impactedFbs render as numbers and the per-document list with its diff widgets renders only after the reader expands the details element (DeltaCounts.expanded true).

[happy] Given the profile register is "engineer", when the tab renders, then the For-engineers DocRow wrapper is absent and every engineer item (failing ids with why, next action, stage states, coverage counts, decisions outstanding, freeze state) is present in a named table or block of the sub-views.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-layout.test.js::AC-18005-4 happy: the profile register is engineer

testCases.description: [happy] Given ready-to-build is "no", when the freeze block renders, then it names each failing gate in plain words with what resolves it, with no button and no command text; given ready-to-build is "yes", it states that the tree can be frozen and what a freeze would record.

[edge] Given a stage acknowledged at the current tree hash, when the grid renders, then VerdictGridCell.state is "acknowledged" and the reason shows on hover, read from stages[].state and one reason helper rather than from freezeRecord.gates directly.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-layout.test.js::AC-18005-6 edge: a stage acknowledged at the current tree hash

testCases.description: [must-not] Given embed mode (data-embed="1") and a viewport narrower than 720px, when the Readiness tab renders, then no table forces horizontal page scroll: tables collapse to stacked rows and the SubTabStrip stays inside the panel.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-layout.test.js::AC-18005-7 must-not: embed mode dataembed1 and a viewport narrower th

testCases.description: [failure] Given a hash whose sub= value is not a known readiness sub-tab key, when the router runs, then the overview sub-view is activated and the unknown value is dropped from the hash.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-layout.test.js::AC-18005-8 failure: a hash whose sub value is not a known readiness
